api_contracts.item: StockRecordOut {sku: string, location: string, quantity: int, batch_number: string|null, serial_number: string|null}; null batch/serial = not tracked; tracking_code is removed from the response by S3-contract-drop-tracking-code (column dropped)

SkuDetailOut {sku: string, locations: [{location: string, quantity: int, batch_number: string|null, serial_number: string|null}]}; null batch/serial = not tracked; tracking_code is removed from the response by S3-contract-drop-tracking-code (column dropped)

persistence_invariants.brief: batch_number and serial_number are added as NULLABLE columns (no NOT NULL, no default): a nonconforming or absent tracking_code yields NULL in both, never a guessed or partial value.

The additive expand migration on pre-existing stock_records: downgrade to its down_revision removes only batch_number/serial_number and every prior row survives with sku, location, quantity and tracking_code unchanged; upgrade head re-adds and re-backfills them.
Column add + backfill run in one migration transaction: a failure leaves stock_records at the prior revision with no partially backfilled rows.
After the expand migration UNIQUE (sku, location) and CHECK (quantity >= 0) are still present and enforced; the backfill never rewrites location from the code's leading segment.

The contract migration (drop tracking_code) on pre-existing stock_records: downgrade to its down_revision re-adds nullable tracking_code rebuilt as location-batch-serial where batch and serial are both non-NULL (else NULL) and every row survives; upgrade head drops it again.
The tracking_code drop runs in one migration transaction: a failure leaves stock_records at the expand revision with tracking_code intact and all rows present.
After the contract migration UNIQUE (sku, location) and CHECK (quantity >= 0) are still present and enforced, and batch_number/serial_number stay nullable.

nfrs.requirement: The expand migration preserves every sprint-1 stock record (count, sku, location, quantity, tracking_code) and is reversible without row loss. The adjustment timestamp/actor clause is N/A to F6 (no adjustments introduced).

fitness_functions.clause: After upgrade, stock_records row count and every row's (sku, location, quantity, tracking_code) equal the pre-upgrade snapshot.
Downgrade to the expand migration's down_revision then upgrade head keeps every row and re-derives the same batch_number/serial_number.

nfrs.fitness_function: On the paired branch, the expand migration's upgrade and its downgrade/upgrade round-trip both leave stock_records' row count and every row's (sku, location, quantity, tracking_code) equal to the pre-upgrade snapshot.

nfrs.requirement: F6 introduces no write path for quantity; the obligation is that the migration leaves CHECK (quantity >= 0) intact. Pick-overcommit is N/A (no pick operation in F6).
nfrs.fitness_function: After the expand migration, inserting a stock_records row with quantity -1 on the paired branch is rejected by CHECK (quantity >= 0).

nfrs.requirement: The expand migration keeps (sku, location) uniquely addressable; location remains canonical and is never rewritten from the code.
nfrs.fitness_function: After the expand migration, inserting a second row for an existing (sku, location) on the paired branch is rejected by the UNIQUE constraint.

nfrs.requirement: Migration, backfill and probe tests run against the paired Lakebase branch (DATABASE_URL, databricks_postgres), never a mock/SQLite/in-memory substitute.
nfrs.fitness_function: The integration test session fixture asserts the engine dialect is postgresql and its URL is the paired branch DATABASE_URL, failing fast otherwise.

nfrs.requirement: Batch/Serial display (S2) stays in the React SPA under client/; the boundary returns JSON only. S1 adds no UI or route.
The integrity probe surfaces the exact nonconforming count as a warning for PO review; it never fails the migration.
nfrs.fitness_function: With N seeded nonconforming codes, the probe returns level 'warning' and nonconforming_count N, and the migration still completes.

nfrs.requirement: The API exposes batch_number/serial_number as nullable fields (never a fabricated value); the SPA renders a NULL field as 'not tracked' per field, never blank, without parsing tracking_code client-side.
nfrs.fitness_function: On the paired branch, a stock record with NULL batch_number and populated serial_number is returned by GET /api/stock and GET /api/skus/{sku} with batch_number null and serial_number set (no client-side split of tracking_code).

nfrs.requirement: The contract migration preserves every stock record (count, sku, location, quantity, batch_number, serial_number) and is reversible without row loss.

fitness_functions.clause: After the contract upgrade, stock_records row count and every row's (sku, location, quantity, batch_number, serial_number) equal the expand-revision snapshot.
Downgrade to the contract migration's down_revision restores tracking_code as location-batch-serial with every row present, and upgrade head drops it again.

nfrs.fitness_function: On the paired branch, the contract migration's upgrade and its downgrade/upgrade round-trip both leave stock_records' row count and every row's (sku, location, quantity, batch_number, serial_number) equal to the expand-revision snapshot.

open_decisions.question: Does the integrity probe block acceptance or only warn?
open_decisions.resolution: Warn with the exact count; PO accepts at review (per feature request).

open_decisions.question: Are >3-segment codes and NULL codes nonconforming (NULL batch/serial, counted by the probe)?
open_decisions.resolution: Yes per feature-spec Data semantics: only exactly three non-empty '-' segments conform; 'A-B-C-D', empty segments and NULL codes are nonconforming and counted.

open_decisions.question: Once S3 drops tracking_code, is the probe retired or re-pointed (it reads tracking_code)?
open_decisions.resolution: Retired: the probe is a pre-acceptance check for the expand step (S1 AC4, gated before S3); the contract change deletes app/services|repositories/tracking_code_integrity.py and drops tracking_code from EP1/EP2 so nothing reads the column. S1 AC4 still holds at the expand revision.
